ObjectName.value: Tonal markers in Quốc âm tân tự 國音新字

Categories.value: PD-Vietnam|PD US expired|Unknown date|PD-old missing SDC copyright status|PD-US missing SDC copyright status|Quốc Âm Tân Tự

ImageDescription.value: Shown here are the tonal markers in Quốc âm tân tự 國音新字. Tones of âm 陰 degree are marked with a small semi-circle, and tones of dương 陽 degree are marked with a small circle mark. For example, đông 東 is marked with a small semi-circle on the bottom-left as (1) it is a tone of âm degree which then is marked with a semi-circle (2) it is marked on the bottom left as the bình 平 tone is typically marked at the bottom-left of a character. Another example would be độc 獨 which is marked with a small circle on the bottom-right as (1) it is a tone of dương degree which then is marked with a circle (2) it is marked on the bottom-right as it is a nhập 入 tone.
